yarar.onu: AI agents forget everything when the chat ends. COUNCIL fills that gap.

maddeler.baslik: A new session does not start from zero
maddeler.cumle: As the session opens, your profile, your rules, your open threads and your latest sessions are in front of the agent.
Your correction becomes one dated line in the rules and loads in every later session.

maddeler.baslik: All your devices share one memory
maddeler.cumle: Move it to a server and all your devices share the same notes; there is no folder to sync.
Notes are plain text; every change stays in the history with when and why it was made.

paneller.govde: It is not tied to one agent: every agent you use reads and writes the same memory.
The six parts of the outer ring are the six basic features of the system.
Notes live in plain files, every change goes into the history, they are searched by keyword and context arrives by itself.
The agent records your decision, preference or correction the moment you state it.
The names of the other {yolda} features are not written yet. A feature is added only once it has passed its tests and measurements.
When a feature is added, its name is written and its part is filled. When all six are filled, version 1.0.0 is released.
